tolerance.rule: Each tolerance is the largest difference seen between the bfloat16 and float32 Hugging Face runs (over the fp32 top-k ids, and over the logsumexp) times the margin, with a floor. A Hyperion bf16 forward sums in a different order than Hugging Face's, so its error against float32 is of the same size as, not identical to, bfloat16's; the margin covers that. Argmax: equal to the float32 argmax, or a token of its tie group: one of the recorded top-k whose float32 logit is within max_abs_top_logits of the best.

criteria: for every compared position: max |our logit - reference logit| over the reference top-k ids <= tolerance.max_abs_top_logits
for every compared position: |our logsumexp - reference logsumexp| <= tolerance.max_abs_logsumexp
positions are compared while our greedy tokens equal the reference's; the first 8 generated tokens must agree
